idea-plugin.name: Valhalla Now
idea-plugin.description:
Valhalla Now - Project Valhalla Nullable Types

Brings Project Valhalla's nullable type syntax to IntelliJ IDEA today! This plugin provides visual transformation and typing assistance for nullable types using JSpecify annotations.

Features

  • Visual Transformation: Displays @Nullable String as String?
  • Typing Assistance: Type ? after a type to automatically insert @Nullable
  • Full Support: Works with fields, parameters, return types, generics, and arrays
  • Smart Validation: Prevents nullable primitives with helpful error messages

Examples

  • Fields: String? instead of @Nullable String
  • Generics: List<String?> instead of List<@Nullable String>
  • Arrays: String[]? for nullable arrays, String?[] for arrays of nullable elements

Leverages JSpecify annotations (org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable) for compatibility with the emerging Project Valhalla nullable type system.
